title: Dan Quinn had an "absolutely fantastic experience" coaching with Mike McCarthy

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dan Quinn had an "absolutely fantastic experience" coaching with Mike McCarthy
sources.description: With Wednesday's rant from former Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers painting a negative picture about Steelers coach Mike McCarthy that extended to his time with both the Packers and the Cowboys, those who have worked with him in those places will inevitably be asked about McCarthy.
